name: Tibetan sky
summary: The twelve zodiac signs of Tibetan astronomy, taken from India with the Kalachakra Tantra and mixed with Chinese influences.

Ari.name: The Sheep
Ari.description: The first sign of the zodiac (lug, “sheep”), the stars of the constellation Aries.

Tau.name: The Ox
Tau.description: The second sign of the zodiac (glang, “ox, bull”), the stars of Taurus with the Hyades and Aldebaran.

Gem.name: The Pair
Gem.description: The third sign of the zodiac (’khrig, “pair”), the constellation Gemini.

Cnc.name: The Crab
Cnc.description: The fourth sign of the zodiac, with a name of Sanskrit origin. Surprisingly, the figure depicted on the stone floor of the Stag Phu observatory of the Lhasa calendar institute looks more like a frog.

Leo.name: The Lion
Leo.description: The fifth sign of the zodiac (seng ge, “lion”), the constellation Leo with the bright Regulus.

Vir.name: The Maiden
Vir.description: The sixth sign of the zodiac (bu mo, “girl”), the constellation Virgo with Spica.

Lib.name: The Scales
Lib.description: The seventh sign of the zodiac (srang, “scales”), the constellation Libra.

Sco.name: The Scorpion
Sco.description: The eighth sign of the zodiac (sdig pa, “scorpion”), the constellation Scorpius with the reddish Antares.

Sgr.name: The Bow
Sgr.description: The ninth sign of the zodiac (gzhu, “bow”), the constellation Sagittarius.

Cap.name: The Water Monster
Cap.description: The tenth sign of the zodiac (chu srin), the counterpart of the Indian makara: a crocodile-like water creature. The constellation Capricornus.

Aqr.name: The Vase
Aqr.description: The eleventh sign of the zodiac (bum pa, “vase, pitcher”), the constellation Aquarius.

Psc.name: The Fish
Psc.description: The twelfth sign of the zodiac (nya, “fish”), the constellation Pisces.
